title: Burn Hollywood Burn
description:
• Artist: Public Enemy
• Featuring: Ice Cube & Big Daddy Kane
• Song: Burn Hollywood Burn
• Producer: Keith Shocklee and Eric Sadler
• Label: Def Jam Recordings
• Year: 1990
• Album: Fear Of A Black Planet
• Director: ***
• Resolution: 1440x1080
• Frames Per Second: 60

🔥 Dive deep into Public Enemy's striking critique of Hollywood with "Burn Hollywood Burn." Joining the ranks of hip-hop luminaries Ice Cube and Big Daddy Kane, this track offers a hard-hitting perspective on the misrepresentation of African Americans in Hollywood. With the directorial expertise of Lionel C. Martin, the video flawlessly complements the song's powerful lyrics. Stay tuned for the rhythmic essence of the track, fueled by the sample "Dance to the Drummer's Beat" by Herman Kelly & Life. Experience the fervor and activism as these icons take on Hollywood's problematic narratives.

#PublicEnemy #ChuckD #FlavorFlav #IceCube #BigDaddyKane #GoldenEraHipHop #90sRap

*Fun Facts*:
1. 🎬 The video was directed by Lionel C. Martin, recognized for his influential role in shaping the visuals of 90s hip-hop and R&B.
2. 🎧 From the acclaimed album "Fear of a Black Planet," "Burn Hollywood Burn" stands out for its bold message on race and representation.
3. 🎤 The collaboration of Public Enemy with Ice Cube and Big Daddy Kane for this anthem brought together three significant voices of 90s rap.
4. 🎶 The track samples the infectious "Dance to the Drummer's Beat" by Herman Kelly & Life, adding an undeniable groove to its socio-political critique.
5. 📺 Throughout their career, Public Enemy has been at the forefront of advocating for racial justice and equality through music.

title: I Got 5 On It
description:
Luniz performing "I Got 5 On It" featuring Michael Marshall, from the Operation Stackola album.

More from Luniz: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL0h4Gxm5MbqlzqL8uWwZGvRyqOQSrjMQU

"I Got 5 on It" is a song by the American rap duo Luniz featuring R&B singer Michael Marshall. It was released in May 1995 as the lead single from the duo's debut album, Operation Stackola (1995). The song achieved high chart positions in Germany, the United Kingdom, and the United States. Its lyrics revolve around sharing the cost of purchasing goods, with the title and chorus mentioning splitting the expense and receiving five dollars' worth. The song received a Platinum certification from the RIAA on October 31, 1995, signifying over a million copies sold in the US.

Connect with Luniz:

https://www.deezer.com/artist/720

Luniz (pronounced Loonies) is a hip hop duo from Oakland, California, in the USA. They started as a group called Luniz Toons and then LuniTunes. The duo is made up of two rappers from the West Coast, Yukmouth and Numskull. They signed with record labels like Virgin Records, Noo Trybe Records, and C-Note Records. They were the main act for C-Note Records. Their most famous song is "I Got 5 on It," which came out in 1995.
